content.text: Rain's likely today, about 90%, so I'd go indoors. Riverbend Community Centre has an Indoor open play gym, Saturdays 9 a.m. to noon, $6 per child, for ages 1 to 5, per their program page. [link-187000] It's 9:30 now, so you'd catch most of it, but their site is the only source I have for those details.
